messages:
felix: Heads-up: Billing flagged multiple invoices where Console shows project=infra-sre but token introspect reports project=partner-beta. Looks like our routing/auth precedence mismatch again
anya: I saw two traces. Auth-proxy injects X-Project for legacy paths; downstream Console rendering still prefers the header for display and for quota attribution
rod: That behavior was intentional historically for compatibility, but after the routing change we left it enabled by default which is causing misattribution
felix: Consequences: wrong quota enforcement, skewed cost dashboards, and some feature gates are misfiring because they check project on the request context
anya: Proposal: canonicalize to validated token claim `project` when present. Fallback to X-Project header only if claim absent. Emit telemetry `project_attr_source{source:introspect|header|none}` and `project_attr_mismatch_total` when header != claim
rod: Also sample traces for mismatches (cap 1/sec/org) so we can audit integrators intentionally relying on header ordering
felix: UX: in the Request inspector show "Attribution: token claim (validated)" or "Attribution: header (legacy)". If mismatch, show a subtle warning "possible mismatch" with an expandable explanation
anya: Implementation plan: change auth-exchange to set X-Effective-Project before routing. Precedence: introspect.claim -> org-compat-flag -> header -> anonymous_project
rod: Org-compat-flag? We'll keep a per-org toggle `allow_legacy_header_attrib`. Default OFF for new orgs, ON for existing orgs to avoid immediate breaks
felix: Rollout steps: (1) add metrics + dashboard panels (2) unit + integration tests (3) behind feature flag (per-cluster) (4) 1% canary -> 10% -> 100% with 48h observation windows
anya: Alerts: if `project_attr_mismatch_total` rate >5x baseline OR any single project's quota burn delta >20%/hour during canary, abort and rollback
rod: Billing wants a daily top-20 mismatch report during the canary and an automated email template to org admins when they hit the mismatch list
billing-oncall: We can monitor and runbook. Ping 24h before canary and we'll stand by. Add an alert to the billing playbook so on-call gets notified on anomalies
felix: BC / comms: send a migration guide for integrators: how to include proper `project` claim in tokens and examples for exchanging header->claim. Recommend 90-day deprecation notice if we plan to change defaults for existing orgs
anya: Timeline estimate: auth-exchange PR + tests 1d, telemetry + dashboards 0.5d, Console toggle + UI 1d, canary infra + runbook 0.5d. Target ship early next week if no blockers
rod: I'll add a feature-flag gate and per-cluster toggles for quick rollback. Also add unit tests verifying precedence order and a thermal test for quota impact
felix: Created INF-9001 to track: "Canonical project attribution to token claims; telemetry + org compatibility toggle"
auth-bot: Created INF-9001: "Canonical project attribution to token claims" assigned to rod, anya
billing-oncall: We'll monitor billing during canary. Please share runbook and email templates ahead of time
felix: Great. Keep PR links and runbook in INF-9001. Let's keep this thread for high-level sync only
rod: Will open the PR today and link it in INF-9001
anya: Thanks all. Small change but high impact for billing correctness
felix: Thanks everyone, will coordinate with SRE for canary window and post plan in #release-war-room
